decisions.reason: The revised draft and revision turnaround times do not change the Canva source platform, artifact, or edit-access requirements.
The schedule change does not alter the requirement to deliver a print-ready PDF.
The turnaround request does not change which tables must be integrated or how they must be treated.
The compressed delivery schedule does not change the single layout pass, final-draft input stage, or full-document coverage.
Although the same message separately changes the branding requirement, that change is independent of the source schedule modification and is already represented.
Receipt of final narrative content starts the delivery clock but does not change the requirement to integrate the proposal content.
The revised turnaround times do not modify the required photo integration or graphic treatment.
The source changes the time allowed for final revisions, not the existing requirement for one revision round.
The delivery turnaround change does not alter the anticipated page count.
The source schedule applies to the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and does not affect the TPEC proposal-design requirement.
